newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Petrobras still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Petrobras still a buy.

text.p: Fator Securities said Monday it maintained its buy recommendation on Brazilian state oil company Petrobras after approval of the country's Oil Law.

-- "Approval of the petroleum law will bring enormous benefits to Petrobras but results will be seen in medium term," Fator analyst Sidney Chamey said in a report. "Production should increase as a result of partnerships with other companies authorized under the new law."

-- He said Petrobras' first-half 1997 net income of 252 million reais was 13 percent less than Fator's forecast of 290 million reais. The result, announced on Friday, was 22 percent less than the company's net income for the same period last year.

-- Gross margin rose to 22.9 percent in the second quarter from 15.5 percent in the first quarter, and to 19.2 percent in the first half versus 18.9 percent in the same period last year, the analyst noted.
-- "Due to lower first-half yearly profit, we are reducing our annual forecast of net income from 812 million reais to 730 million reais for 1997," he wrote.
-- He set a 12-month price target of 400 reais, giving an upside potential of 37 percent over the current price.
-- "The implicit growth in the multiples makes us reaffirm our buy recommendation in the medium and long term," he added.
-- Petrobras preferred fell 2.33 percent to end at 294 reais Monday, while its common dropped 3.19 percent to close at 243 reais on the Sao Paulo bourse.
